schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

post.description:
Identify the platform and return ONLY the media options that platform authorizes.

`status` tells the client what to show: `downloadable` (pick an option), `link_only`
(open officially), `needs_connection` (connect account), `not_configured`, `export_only`,
or `unavailable` (with `explanation`). Invalid or unsafe links return 422.

get.description: The capability registry. `configured=false` means the operator hasn't supplied credentials.

patch.description: Device reports progress / outcome. Records are deleted on completion if the user turned off history.

post.description: Create an anonymous principal for this install. No personal data is collected.
Attach email + password to the current anonymous principal (keeps its history and connections).

delete.description: Permanently delete the account and all server-side data (sessions, connections, history).
Delete every download record and cached analysis for this account.
